deployment.readiness: Wrangler deployment completed, deployment list identified matching production source, custom-domain HTML and assets matched the clean Git archive build.

unitFirst.cause: Existing Chinese PDF export test exceeded its unchanged 5000ms timeout.

releasePrivacyPriorToCommit.scope: Previously completed runtime/real-SDK checks apply to unchanged file-processing and analytics logic. These are not newly executed production privacy tests.

method.foldedFaqs: Static summary and answer text is included even when details is initially closed.
method.repeatedHelper: The entire shared .result-reading-guide helper is excluded so its repeated operating tips cannot meet the per-tool editorial minimum.
method.blogRoot: .blog-prose only; frontmatter, byline, cover, practical take, template FAQs and related links are excluded.
method.chinese: Record Han characters and segmented words. Require local unique IDs, Chinese editorial headings/paragraphs, field rows and labelled illustrations. Record English/Chinese section, paragraph and field counts without demanding identical structures; manual semantic-equivalence review remains required.

method.engine: Playwright Chromium, reduced-motion mobile viewport; browser default zoom retained
method.text: Computed fonts for rendered authored text nodes, inputs and generated before/after content; hidden/inert/screen-reader-only trees excluded.
method.touch: Measured main upload controls, mobile navigation/language options, editorial guide links and visible result controls. Ordinary inline prose links are not primary touch targets.
method.tables: Page overflow, table bounds outside the viewport and inner horizontal table overflow fail. CSS overflow mode is also recorded so a contained scroll area can be distinguished from page overflow.
method.results: Six real uploaded states in all four languages at 320px; English states also at375/390/430px. PNG cleanup requires an explicit recorded button click.
method.fixtures: Synthetic teaching files only. MP4 is container-only/non-playable; WAV has a known quick-parser warning; C2PA uses an unsigned JPEG.
method.requests: Analytics/RUM event endpoints and all non-GET/HEAD requests intercepted; this layout test is not analytics execution or privacy certification.
method.evidence: New output JSON and failure screenshots are preserved; existing output filenames are never overwritten.

limitations: Google approval/indexing is not inferred from deployment.
Private AdSense Sites/backend evidence and previously accepted licensing Unknowns are unchanged.
Mobile layout test intercepts analytics/RUM endpoints; it is separate from real-SDK privacy verification.
retainedFailures: First unit timeout and full passing retry logs retained.
First deployment connectivity failure and passing retry logs retained.
A failed deployment-list query and successful retry are retained.
